_about: Phase 6 scorecard, pre-registered 2026-11-22 with config/phase6_criteria.json before any scored run. Items S1-S4 prove the evaluation is sound; S5 is a quality target for the real model and can fail. Accuracy itself has no target: it is reported with intervals, and the decision rule says what follows from it.

S1_gold_correct.means: every correct answer in the set is recomputed a second way and the set is unchanged since pre-registration

S2_runs_complete_within_budget.means: each question run exactly once per model, fully recorded, tool results reproducible, spend within the caps

S3_grading_proven.means: the grader accepts correct answers, catches planted wrong ones, and an independent re-grade agrees on every answer

S4_comparison_reported.means: the generated report gives accuracy with intervals, the paired comparison, made-up facts and cost, and applies the fixed decision rule

S5_phase4_answers_grounded_and_safe.means: Haiku's live answers to the nine Phase 4 questions meet Phase 4's grounding and safety criteria
